summary: Centessa Pharmaceuticals plc filed an 8-K reporting that its shareholders approved the acquisition by Eli Lilly & Company via a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement under UK law. The deal involves Lilly acquiring all of Centessa's outstanding share capital. As of the record date, 154,731,309 ordinary shares were outstanding; 126,676,463 shares were voted, with the scheme proposal receiving sufficient votes to pass. The board recommended the transaction. This UK scheme is equivalent to a US merger and requires court sanction as a final step. What to watch: the court hearing date and regulatory clearances; risk-arb focuses on timing and any last-minute conditions.
